      🤖 AI Financing Recommendation

      Based on your intake data, all financing structures are scored and ranked. Click any card to jump to that calculator.

      🏦 Conventional
      🏛 FHA / 203k
      ⚡ Hard Money
      📊 DSCR Loan
      🏦 Conventional Loan
      HOW IT WORKS
      Standard 30-year amortizing mortgage from a bank. You put down a percentage, the lender finances the rest. Predictable monthly payment, requires income/credit qualification. PMI applies if down payment < 20%.
      📅 Amortization Schedule
      🔢 NOI / Cap Rate / Price Calculator
      Enter any two — the third is calculated automatically
      Formula: Price = NOI ÷ Cap Rate  |  Cap Rate = NOI ÷ Price  |  NOI = Price × Cap Rate     
      🏛 FHA / 203k Loan
      HOW IT WORKS
      Government-insured loan with a low 3.5% down payment. The 203k version rolls rehab funds into the same loan. Owner-occupancy required. Mortgage insurance lasts the life of the loan, but qualifying credit/income bar is lower than conventional.
      📅 Amortization Schedule
      YearBeg BalAnn PmtPrincipalInterestMIPEnd Bal
      ⚡ Hard Money / Bridge
      HOW IT WORKS
      Short-term asset-based loan from private lenders. High rate (10–12%), low LTV (65–75%), 6–24 month term. No income docs — they underwrite the deal, not you. Used for fix-and-flip or quick close, then refinance into conventional/DSCR at exit.
      📊 DSCR Loan ?
      HOW IT WORKS
      Loan qualified on the property's rental income (Debt Service Coverage Ratio), not your personal income. No W-2 / tax returns needed. Requires DSCR ≥ 1.0–1.25 (rent covers debt service). Rate runs ~0.5–1% higher than conventional, LLC vesting allowed.
      📅 Amortization Schedule
      YearBeg BalAnn PmtPrincipalInterestEnd Bal
      🔒 Subject-To
      📋 Seller Finance
      🔑 Lease-Option
      🔒 Subject-To (Take Over Existing Mortgage)
      HOW IT WORKS
      You take title via deed. The seller's existing mortgage stays in their name. You make payments on their behalf. No qualifying required. Due-on-sale clause risk.
      📅 Existing Loan Schedule 🔒
      YearBeg BalAnnual Pmt 🔒PrincipalInterestEnd BalCum Interest
      📋 Seller Finance — Stacked Loans
      HOW IT WORKS
      Seller carries notes in one or more positions. Add up to 3 loans (e.g., 1st position bank loan + 2nd position seller carry, or all-seller-finance). Each loan has its own rate, amort period, and balloon term.
      📌 Loan 1 (e.g., Bank / DSCR / Hard Money)
      📌 Loan 2 (e.g., Seller Carry / 2nd Position)
      📌 Loan 3 (Optional — 3rd Position / Equity Kicker)
      🔑 Lease-Option / Rent-to-Own
      HOW IT WORKS
      Tenant pays option fee (non-refundable) for the right to buy at a locked strike price. Monthly rent credit accumulates toward down payment. If they walk, you keep option fee + credits.
      ⚡ MORBY METHOD — Seller Carry (50%) + Bank Loan (50%) Deal Structure
      Seller finances ~50% at 0-low% · Bank/DSCR covers rest · If bank LTV > purchase price → cash back to you

      📋 Seller Carry (~50% of Purchase)
      Seller finances their equity as a note. Often 0% interest — they get monthly cash flow with no tax hit. Typically 50% of purchase price.

      💰 Velocity Banking Calculator

      Compare standard mortgage payoff against the LOC-chunking strategy. Pre-fills from the deal in Intake when available.
      📊 Inputs
      Mortgage
      LOC / HELOC
      Monthly cash flow
      ⚖ Comparison

      —

      Interest saved
      $0
      0 chunks
      📉 Balance over time
      ⚠ About this strategy
      Velocity banking uses a line of credit (typically a HELOC) to make principal "chunks" against a higher-interest mortgage, then aggressively pays down the LOC using monthly cash flow. The math here is faithful to that model. Important caveats: HELOCs are usually variable-rate — if the LOC rate climbs above the mortgage rate, the strategy can lose money. Most independent analyses show real-world savings are modest vs. simply applying the same monthly surplus directly to the mortgage as extra principal. Use the Mortgage Extra Payment comparison row below before committing to a HELOC strategy.

      📊 Account Overview
      👥 Users
      Click any row to drill into that user\'s profile + saved underwriting projects.
      ➕ Add User Manually Bypass signup — admin-only
      Creates an auth account with email auto-confirmed. The user will receive a one-time magic link you can share. Optionally pre-grant a role (admin / moderator) and mark them as comp (free-for-life).
      🔑 Roles & Permissions Grant view-only or moderation rights to other accounts
      admin = full read + write + can grant/revoke other admins + sees activity logs. moderator = read all profiles+projects + can change subscription_status (no log access). The grantee must already have an account (signed in once).
      📜 Activity Logs ADMIN ONLY
      Every privileged write (grant role, change subscription, toggle admin) is auto-recorded. Admin actions log shows app-level events; Auth events show Supabase sign-ins / password resets / token refreshes; Grant history shows the full lifecycle of role grants (including revoked).

      🛡 Underwriting Discipline

      Lender + appraiser deal-killer guards. Conservative overlay, reverse cap solver, seller-truth-vs-your-truth, tax/rent/market gates, KP profile, seller-finance compatibility.
      🛡 Conservative Overlay
      One click locks: 10% vacancy floor · 50% expense floor (55% if owner pays utilities) · exit cap +50bps · $250/unit replacement reserve · DSCR floor 1.25x · LTV cap 70% on deals > $1M. Encodes Michael Blank / Nighthawk Equity discipline.
      🔢 Reverse Cap Solver — Max Offer Price
      Given the cap rate you'll accept and your adjusted NOI (after conservative overlay), solve for the maximum price the deal pencils at.
      ⚖ Seller-Truth vs Your-Truth Pro Forma
      Side-by-side comparison: what the seller/broker reports vs your conservative re-underwriting. Highlights deltas + missing-line warnings.
      🏛 Tax Record Reconciliation
      80–90% of failed deals trace to a tax-record mismatch. Enter both numbers — flag if delta > 5%.
      👤 Key Principal (KP) Profile
      Lenders gate loan terms on KP credit + track record. Agency baseline: NW ≥ loan, liq ≥ 9-10%, FICO ≥ 650, 1+ yr similar-asset experience.
      🌆 Market Tier & Rural Disqualifier
      🤝 Seller-Finance Lender Compatibility
      🎯 Fundraising Probability
      📉 Stress-Test Battery
      Apply lender-style adverse scenarios to your current deal. Each scenario stresses one input; the "Combined" row applies them simultaneously. Pass = DSCR ≥ 1.20x AND debt yield ≥ 8%.
      📕 Auto Investor Deck
      One-click deck pulling from Intake + Metrics + Partners + Discipline + Stress. 11 sections in a print-ready page that opens in a new window (Cmd-P → Save as PDF). Use this as the canonical investor packet.
      • Cover · Investment Highlights · Property Overview · Sources & Uses · Year-1 Pro Forma · Business Plan · Sensitivity / Stress · Exit Strategy · Returns Summary (whole-deal + per-investor) · Risk Factors · Sponsor / KP
